planSummary: Self-review pass 2: requirement alignment, test coverage, and missing evidence. Walked every obligation in the story/tech-design/test-plan handoff against implemented evidence. AC-3.1 (owners' surfaces only): verified structurally — sweep.ts imports only type vocabulary plus messages/turns index surfaces, zero sqlite/openThreadDatabase/work_item/derived_form touches; behaviorally pinned by the five-op zero-provider test and the work-row read-backs through openRaw. AC-3.2: TC-3.1's elapsed bound plus an anti-shim grep (no drainSettled/polling in sweep.ts or the surface). AC-3.3: TC-3.1 covers all five seeded states — blocked lives on the sacrificial sibling thread per the design's own fixture spec (FC-0.3 puts blocked source-damage on a sibling), so the blocked leg is a sibling sweep, design-conformant. AC-3.4: TC-3.2 plus the structural owner-noop leg (turn pair sharing one work item). AC-3.5: receipt lines asserted per owner/kind with reasons for failed and blocked. AC-3.6: TC-3.4 skip + default-embed + heal legs, with the heal riding the background scheduler via the requeue's poke-on-commit and the healed form proven in the served view (boundary-seeded pull renders the ready summary). AC-3.7: standalone-vs-embedded same shape holds by construction (both call sites share runSweep — verified) and the shared schema validator passes both; the CLI execution leg is the story's own explicit Scope-out to Story 5. Classification table is data with the unclassified-permanent default tested at unit, production-write-path, and receipt levels. Gate-before-first-commit obligation satisfied (recorded in the team-impl-log; nothing committed yet). One evidence gap found and fixed this pass: view-sweep.test.ts was not recorded in the red-manifest, so the test-immutability gate would not have covered it going forward — recorded (37 files now) and green-verify re-run clean.

No waiting, no provider calls, no direct work_item/derived_form writes (verified structurally this pass).

findingsFixed: Pass 2: view-sweep.test.ts was missing from test/red-manifest.json, so the test-immutability gate would not have protected the new suite after this story closes (prior stories recorded their new test files). Recorded via scripts/record-red-manifest.mjs (manifest now 37 files); green-verify re-run clean (273 tests, immutability OK).
Pass 1 (carried): TC-3.4 heal leg rewritten from a touch-suppressed background status call to a background-SDK compact whose requeue poke-on-commit drives the production repair path.
findingsSurfaced: AC-3.7's CLI execution leg is deferred to Story 5's process suite by the story's own Scope-out; the shared receipt-schema validator landed here so the Story 5 leg asserts the same checker — verifier should confirm this deferral reading.

TC-3.1's blocked state is asserted on the sacrificial sibling thread rather than the main fixture thread — this follows the design's own fixture specification (blocked source-damage lives on a sibling, FC-0.3/test-plan §Test Substrate), not a coverage shortcut.
Untested edge (schema-valid, outside the plan's TC set): sweep on a thread with no derived forms returns an empty-owners receipt; no test pins it.

If an owner requeue fails mid-walk, sweep returns the error and that invocation's receipt is lost; already-committed requeues are durable (each is its own owner transaction) and surface as in-flight on the next sweep. Receipt-level partial-failure accounting was not specified.

Default-on sweep means compact now legitimately mutates derivation state on a thread with transient failures; view-compact.test.ts's record-untouched assertions depend on the file's first default compact performing the one requeue — order coupling documented in the amended test comment.
